dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: I imagine you'll wanna keep fighting soon — do you want a bite to eat first? You know you love my cooking!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: You should never work on an empty stomach! More importantly, a proper meal will put you in a good mood, and you'll handle yourself better in a crisis.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Here, some chopsticks for ya. Don't be shy now, dig in!
